categories.main_business_segments: De Licacy Industrial Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the textile industry, focusing on the manufacturing and trading of various fabrics including short fiber and long fiber textiles. The company also engages in dyeing, finishing, and processing of textiles, as well as garment manufacturing through recent acquisitions. Other business segments include wholesale and retail of fabrics, chemical dyes and pigments, pollution control equipment, industrial park development, and factory leasing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs vertically integrated production processes covering yarn preparation, weaving, dyeing, finishing, and advanced post-processing such as coating and lamination. It emphasizes R&D in functional and eco-friendly textiles, including recycled fibers, multi-layer composite fabrics, and high-performance materials with properties like water repellency, UV protection, antibacterial, moisture-wicking, and thermal insulation. Automation and computer information systems are increasingly adopted to enhance production efficiency and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: De Licacy serves international brand customers primarily in the outdoor functional apparel, sportswear, casual wear, and home furnishing fabric markets. Key customers include well-known brands in North America, Europe, and Japan such as UA, Columbia, Adidas, and Uniqlo. The company also collaborates with domestic and overseas trading companies and garment manufacturers, targeting final buyers and brand clients to stabilize orders and expand market reach.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with production facilities in Tainan and overseas subsidiaries in Vietnam and China. Its sales markets cover Asia (notably Taiwan, Japan, Southeast Asia), Europe (including Northern Europe and Italy), and North America. The company has representative offices in Shanghai and Taipei and maintains a global supply chain with a focus on expanding in emerging markets and leveraging free trade agreements in ASEAN countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: De Licacy occupies a midstream to downstream position in the textile supply chain, focusing on fabric production, dyeing, finishing, and garment manufacturing. It integrates upstream yarn processing and downstream garment production through vertical integration and strategic acquisitions, enhancing supply chain flexibility and responsiveness to brand customers' needs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes developing environmentally friendly, functional, and fashionable textile products, investing in R&D for recycled fibers, water-soluble yarns, multi-layer laminates, and high-performance coatings. It aims to deepen collaboration with brand customers and final buyers, expand global market coverage, especially in sports and outdoor apparel, and enhance production competitiveness in Vietnam. Sustainability and compliance with international environmental standards are key strategic themes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of textile products including short and long fiber fabrics, functional and eco-friendly textiles, and garments. The company also earns income from related services such as dyeing and finishing processing. It leverages strategic partnerships and direct sales to brand customers and trading companies to secure stable order flows.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: De Licacy positions itself as a leading Taiwanese textile manufacturer specializing in high-value, differentiated functional fabrics with strong R&D capabilities. It competes with other textile producers in Taiwan, China, and Southeast Asia by focusing on product innovation, vertical integration, and sustainability. The company maintains competitive advantages through comprehensive production lines, quality certifications, and close relationships with international brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$12 billion, representing a 22% growth over the prior year, with net profit increasing by over 340% to NT$516 million. The company has a stable financial structure with total assets exceeding NT$16 billion and equity of nearly NT$6 billion. It continues to invest in capacity expansion, R&D, and strategic acquisitions, demonstrating a positive growth trajectory despite global economic uncertainties.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: De Licacy emphasizes high-quality, innovative, and environmentally sustainable textile products tailored to meet the evolving demands of international brand customers. Its vertically integrated production and strong R&D capabilities enable rapid product development and customization. The company differentiates itself through advanced functional fabrics, eco-friendly materials, and compliance with global environmental standards, providing comprehensive solutions that enhance customer competitiveness and market responsiveness.
